cli.update_help.update: Upgrade this install from PyPI. Not the lop-update script, which rebuilds the global runtime from a local git checkout.
cli.update_help.check: Print installed vs PyPI; do not install
cli.update_help.from_snapshot: Install a local source tree (a directory, or a git ref of the current repository) into its own install generation. On macOS, a ref that is exactly a published release installs the published wheel from PyPI — the only build carrying the macOS key agent — and every other ref is built from source.
cli.update_help.allow_downgrade: Allow --from-snapshot to install a build OLDER than the current install (a deliberate rollback; recorded in the install marker). Without --from-snapshot it is refused on the PyPI path, which only installs newer versions; the refresh flags take precedence.
cli.update_help.no_services: Do not bring the `lop serve` daemons onto the new build; the supervised daemons are still repaired. Use this only when something else will start the serves, e.g. a script that owns their launch.
cli.update_help.no_roll: Do not queue a mesh rollout for this update, whatever `network.rollout_on_update` says; `lop network update` still rolls by hand.
